root_cause: The repository measured generic queue and workflow fan-out but did not distinguish Required latency or enforce a monotone budget on globally-triggered pull_request workflows. The daily optimizer could tune parallelism but had no architecture ratchet, and it also started a PR workflow when its own files changed.
prevention: Measure Required queue/total p95, active external work and unscoped PR topology daily. Keep protected-pr-fastlane as the current authority. The optimizer may reduce the unscoped PR workflow budget toward Required + CodeQL = 2 but may never raise it automatically; any tuning still lands only through protected PR gates.
